scope: Small mobile camera presentation change; syntax and focused source review only.
source_review: The existing world scale is multiplied by 0.85 only when BractwoMobile.active() is true.
The same mobile media query is shared with the HUD; resize recalculates the scale after orientation changes.
mobile.js is loaded before game.js, so active() exists before the initial resize call.
Pointer-to-world conversion, hit testing, world visibility, ground chunks and minimap camera bounds already use camera.scale.
Joystick direction uses its DOM rectangle, and no UI/CSS dimensions or desktop scale are changed.
deployment: Local source and release packages only; no live deployment or player database changes.
